verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth documents encrypted backup and sync to the user's own iCloud or Google Drive, plus export files, explicitly to protect against losing tokens if the phone is damaged or lost. The step-by-step recovery page it cites covers the 2FAS Pass vault, not Auth tokens, so the restore-on-new-device path for tokens is only implied. Missing for 10: step-by-step first-party restore instructions for 2FAS Auth tokens on a new device; independent or hands-on confirmation that the restore works.

support.subject: As an everyday user, losing my phone doesn't lose my accounts — a documented recovery path restores my tokens on a new device

citations.quote: You can enable secure data syncing with your personal iCloud or Google Drive to protect yourself from losing Tokens in case of phone damage or loss.
Even if you lose your mobile device, you can recover service keys because they are stored in a secure cloud backup.
Synchronize your Tokens with 2FAS export files, iCloud or Google Drive.
